text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the middle of the training camp period, Transcend and I traveled all the way out to Niigata Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The "Leopard Stakes". This was Transcend's first graded stakes goal, but...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-chan, Trainer-chan.
I've got some juicy, juicy, juicy scoop!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, there's a real big shot
in the stands today.
choice_data_list: Big shot... you mean an Uma Musume?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
No, it's not Umamusume,
what they're coming to see is—

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: It sounds like something a Dubai billionaire would have.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Who knows? Maybe they're scouting ahead to snatch up an Umamusume who looks like she'll make it big on dirt?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"If I catch their eye,
maybe I'll even get invited to an international GⅠ in Dubai...?"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
No way, that can't be it...
Still, that might put a bit of pressure on me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Transcend is shivering.
Even if she's somewhat used to the crowd's gaze,
the pressure from the Dubai billionaire is intense.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: A chance? What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I see... Right. That's one way to look at it.
And on top of that...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
If I play my cards right, I might really get closer to them.
A wealthy friend is truly a friend in need.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, Trai-chan.
I think I've calmed down a bit.
Let's get going, then.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I went outside... it was true.
Surrounded by several guards, someone who seemed
to be a VIP from Dubai was looking at the paddock.
choice_data_list: Tran! This is your shot at Dubai!
Tran! It's your chance for Dubai!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, so it really was true after all.
Whether it'll actually catch anyone's eye is another matter, though..."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
This tension... actually feels kinda nice.
Let's show 'em that I've got what it takes
to be a proper main character too.
